title: US reportedly plans new Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners
summary: The US government is reportedly planning new Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU, targeting manufacturing overcapacity; China would face an additional 20% on top of the 25% tariffs imposed in 2018, and the new China tariff could rise to 40% if China does not comply with the October 2025 Busan trade truce.
